responsibility: Primary declaration-processing file for the C++ front end. It builds and validates declarations, initializes the cp_global_trees universe, manages variables, functions, types, scopes, and predefined entities, processes initializers and storage/layout concerns, and supplies many core helpers for declaration semantics such as auto-deduction checks, explicit-specifier building, COMDAT grouping, and the front-end’s global/static declaration state.
same_name_distinction: Implements the substantive declaration-processing engine: building declarations and types, initializing cp_global_trees, handling initialization/storage/layout details, and enforcing declaration semantics. Unlike decl.h, it is the large implementation body, not the small shared header for declarator-context enums and a few declarations.
